1.1: When I, Ezekiel, was thirty years old, I was living alongside the Kebar River, among the Israelite people whom the Babylonians had forcibly removed from the land of Judah. It was on the fifth day of the fourth month that the sky looked as though it was opening, and God showed me visions from heaven.
1.2: That day was almost five years after the Babylonian King Nebuchadnezzar forcibly removed King Jehoiachin from Jerusalem.
1.3: God spoke his messages directly to me, Ezekiel the priest, Buzi’s son, at the time when I lived in the land of the Chaldeans, along the Kebar River. Yahweh empowered me to receive what God wanted me to see and hear. \
1.4: Then I looked, and what I saw was a windstorm coming out of the north. It took the shape of a large cloud with a massive fire burning within itself. A brilliant light radiated all around the storm, and its center glowed like hot metal in a fire.
1.5: In the very center of the windstorm appeared what seemed to be four creatures. Here is what they looked like — they resembled humans,
1.6: but every one of them had four different faces and four wings. \
1.7: Their two legs were straight, like human legs, but their two feet resembled the hooves of calves, and they glowed like the glimmer of polished bronze.
1.8: Each creature had human hands, which rested underneath the wing that was on each of their four sides. As for their four faces and four wings —
1.9: each creature’s wing touched the wing of another, so that, together, the four creatures formed a square. Whenever they moved, they did not turn, but instead moved forward in the direction of one of their four faces.
1.10: Now, their faces looked like this: In front, each creature had a face that resembled a human face. The face on the right side resembled a lion’s face. The face on the left side resembled an ox’s face, and the face in the back resembled an eagle’s face.
1.11: That was what their faces looked like. As for their wings, each creature had his four wings raised and spread out above them. Two of each creature’s wings touched two of the wings of the other creatures that were on either side of it. The other two wings they folded so as to cover their bodies.
1.12: Without turning as they went, these creatures always moved in the direction of one of their faces. They advanced in whichever direction their spirit guided them. \
1.13: The form of the four creatures resembled glowing charcoal in the middle of a blazing fire or like flaming torches. Their fire flashed back and forth among the four creatures. It gave off a brilliant, fiery light, and streaks of lightning darted out of the fire.
1.14: Yes, the creatures were moving back and forth so rapidly that they resembled lightning strikes! \
1.15: Then I looked at the creatures, and what I saw was a single wheel on the ground beside each of the four-faced creatures.
1.16: Each wheel was identical, and they and their inner wheel appeared to shine like a fine topaz. In terms of their construction, each wheel was made of a single wheel inside of another wheel. \
1.17: Without rotating as they went, the wheels likewise always moved in one of the four directions corresponding to one of the faces of the four-faced creatures.
1.18: As for the outer rims of the wheels — they were towering and terrifying, and each one of the four creatures’ wheels was completely covered with eyes! \
1.19: Whenever the creatures advanced, their wheels advanced alongside them. Likewise, whenever the creatures ascended above the ground, so too did their wheels.
1.20: The four creatures’ wheels advanced in whichever direction their spirit guided them. Likewise, the wheels rose alongside their creature, because the wheels contained the creature’s spirit that gave them life. \
1.21: Whenever the four creatures advanced, their wheels also advanced. Whenever the creatures stopped moving, their wheels also stopped. And whenever the creatures rose above the ground, their wheels also rose alongside. This was because the wheels contained the creatures’ spirit that gave them life. \
1.22: Above the heads of the creatures, there was something that resembled a vaulted dome. It was awesome and glistened like crystals of ice, arching high over their heads.
1.23: Under the vaulted dome, each creature’s four wings were stretched out — two were touching the wings of the other creatures that were on either side of it, and two were folded to cover the creature’s body. \
1.24: Then I heard the noise that their wings made when the four creatures advanced. The noise of their wings sounded like the crashing of ocean waves, or like the voice of the all-powerful God. It sounded like the din of a massive crowd of people, or like the uproar of an army marching to war. Whenever the creatures stopped, they lowered their outstretched wings.
1.25: Then the creatures stopped and lowered their outstretched wings. A voice coming from above the vaulted dome that was over their heads began to speak. \
1.26: Above the vaulted dome that arched high over the heads of the four creatures, there was something that resembled a throne. It looked like someone had hewn it from a large sapphire stone. And high above the dome on that sapphire throne sat someone who appeared to look like a man. \
1.27: I noticed that, above what seemed like his waist, the bodily form of this human-like creature resembled the glowing of hot metal, completely enclosed by fire. Then, I noticed that the bodily form below what seemed like his waist resembled a blazing fire. Radiating all around, brilliant light
1.28: shone like a rainbow in the clouds on a rainy day. This is what the glorious, brilliant light coming from Yahweh looked like. This light displayed how powerful and glorious Yahweh is while he appeared to me. When I saw all of this, I threw myself face down on the ground. Then, I heard the human-like creature who was sitting on that sapphire throne begin to speak. \

2.1: The one sitting on the throne said to me, “Human, stand up! Then I will speak to you.”
2.2: As he said this, God’s Spirit came upon me and enabled me to stand up. Then I heard the one sitting on the throne speak to me.
2.3: He said, “Human, I am about to send you to the Israelite people. Every one of the family clans of Israel has rejected my authority and refused to obey me as my people, like they promised to do. They, like their ancestors, have never stopped openly defying me — even to this very day! \
2.4: My children, the people of Israel, are obstinate and stubborn. I am sending you to talk to them on my behalf. You must declare to them what I, the Lord Yahweh, am speaking to them directly.
2.5: As for them, when you declare my messages, the Israelite people may indeed heed what you tell them, or they may yet refuse to listen. After all, these people reject my authority and openly defy me! Nevertheless, they will eventually admit that a prophet has been among them, and that Yahweh himself is speaking to them! \
2.6: But as for you, human, you must not be afraid of them, nor fear what they say. These people will be as hurtful to you as thorns and thistles are to your skin! Living among them will be like living among scorpions! Still, you must not allow what they say about you to make you afraid, or let their presence terrify you. After all, these people reject my authority and openly defy me! \
2.7: Nonetheless, declare my message to them. The Israelite people may indeed heed what you tell them, or they may still refuse to listen. After all, they openly defy me!
2.8: As for you, human, you must heed whatever I say to you. You must not openly defy me like these people frequently do! Now, open your mouth! Eat what I am about to give you.” \
2.9: Then, as I watched, I saw him stretch out his hand to me, and I saw that he was holding a scroll that contained writing.
2.10: He unfurled the scroll so that I could see it. On both sides of it, someone had written the words of poems that expressed despair, grief, and warning. \

3.1: The one sitting on the throne said to me, “Human, eat it. Yes, eat this scroll! Then, go! Declare my message to the Israelite people.”
3.2: I opened my mouth wide, and he fed the scroll to me.
3.3: Then he said to me, “Human, chew and swallow the scroll that I have given to you. Fill your stomach with it.” I did so, and it tasted as sweet as honey in my mouth. \
3.4: Then he said to me, “Human, it is time for you to go to the Israelite people, so that you might declare my message to them.
3.5: The people to whom I am sending you do not speak a language that is so complex that it is difficult to speak or understand. I am sending you to your own Israelite people.
3.6: Again, I am not sending you to many different people who speak languages that are too complex, whose language you cannot understand. If I were to send you to those people, they would heed your message!
3.7: Yet the Israelite people will never want to heed what you say. After all, they do not even want to heed what I, Yahweh, say! This is because all of them are obstinate and stubborn. \
3.8: But, pay attention! I have enabled you to be as obstinate to them as they are to me, and as stubbornly opposed to them as they are to me!
3.9: I have enabled you to be more resolute and dangerous to the Israelite people than a thorn that is extremely hard! Still, you must not allow them to make you afraid or let their presence terrify you. After all, these people reject my authority and openly defy me!” \
3.10: Then he said to me, “Human, think very carefully about everything I say to you, and listen to it attentively.
3.11: So now, go to your own people, your fellow Israelites, whom the Babylonians have forcibly removed from the land of Judah, so that you can talk to them. You must declare to them what I, the Lord Yahweh, am speaking to them directly. You must do this whether the Israelite people heed what you tell them or whether they refuse to listen.” \
3.12: Then God’s Spirit lifted me up. Behind me, I heard something that sounded like a massive earthquake. The sound sounded like someone shouting the words, “Praise our glorious Yahweh in the temple!”
3.13: I also heard the noise of the wings of the four creatures as they began to flap and brush against the other creatures’ wings, along with the noise of the wheels advancing alongside them. All of this sounded as if it were a massive earthquake. \
3.14: Then God’s Spirit carried me up and took me away from the river. Yet, as I went, I was resentful and angry, and Yahweh was powerfully authorizing me to declare his message.
3.15: So, I went to the people whom the Babylonians had forcibly removed from Judah and resettled in the town of Tel Aviv near the Kebar River in Babylon. There, where they were living, I sat down and did not move for seven days. I sat there among them, completely overwhelmed. \
3.16: After those seven days had ended, Yahweh spoke this message to me,
3.17: “Human, I have appointed you to be like a watchman for the people of Israel. So listen to what I say, and warn them for me.
3.18: Suppose I tell you to tell a sinful person that he is certainly going to die because of his sins, but you do not warn him. If you do not try to keep him alive by saying something to warn that sinful person to stop sinning wickedly, then that sinful person will die because he has sinned, but I will hold you responsible for his death, since you did not act to prevent it.
3.19: But suppose you do warn that sinful person, but he does not stop sinning; he persists in his sinful lifestyle. Then he will die because of his sinful behavior but you will have saved your own life from my punishing. \
3.20: Alternatively, a just person might cease his honest behavior and begin acting unjustly. When that happens, I may cause something very bad to happen to him. Then that person will die. If you did not warn him that he deserved to die if he did not repent of his sin, the formerly just person will die as a sinner. I will not credit him for the just things that he once did. However, I will consider that you are responsible for his death, since you did not act to prevent it.
3.21: However, you might choose to warn that previously just person, so that he ceases his sinful behavior and returns to his just lifestyle. If this happens, that individual will continue to live because you warned him that he would die because of his sin. Furthermore, as for you, you will have prevented me from punishing you.” \
3.22: Then, Yahweh was powerfully present with me there. He spoke to me, “Stand up, and travel to the valley outside of town. At that place, I will talk to you.”
3.23: So, I stood up and went out to the valley. There, I suddenly saw the powerful and glorious vision of Yahweh standing before me. It was just like the glorious vision that I had seen when I was beside the Kebar River. When I saw it, I threw myself face down on the ground. \
3.24: Then, God’s Spirit came upon me and enabled me to stand up. Yahweh said to me, “Go into your house and lock yourself inside it.
3.25: As for you, human — pay attention! The people who live near you will tie you up with ropes, so that you will be unable to go out among them. \
3.26: And I will make you unable to speak, as if you were mute and your tongue was stuck to the top of your mouth. So, I will make it impossible for you to pronounce my rebukes against these people. After all, every one of the Israelite people continuously refuses to listen to me or obey me!
3.27: However, whenever I tell you my messages, I will empower you to declare them to the Israelite people. You must declare to the people what I, the Lord Yahweh, am speaking to them directly. The one who is willing to listen to me will listen, but the one who refuses to accept my message will continue to refuse me. After all, they are all people who continuously reject me and disobey me!” \

4.1: Yahweh continued to speak to me, “As for you, human, find yourself a large clay brick. Then, you should place it in front of you and draw a picture of the city of Jerusalem on it.
4.2: Then, lay siege to the brick! Build siege walls around it and construct a siege ramp! Make camps for enemy soldiers around the brick! Assemble battering rams around the brick of Jerusalem!
4.3: Then, find yourself an iron frying pan, and set it so that it resembles a vast iron wall. It should separate you and your drawing of Jerusalem on the clay brick. Then, turn to face it with firm resolve to besiege the city. This will be a warning for the Israelite people that I am about to judge them. \
4.4: Next, you should lie down on your left side and carry the entirety of the sins of the people of Israel. You must continue to lie there for a certain number of days, to represent enduring the punishment for the sins of the Israelite people.
4.5: Now, I myself have determined the exact length of time that you should do this; one day for each year they have sinned against me. So you must stay in this position for 390 days, to represent the sinful actions of the Israelite people. \
4.6: When you have finished lying on your left side for 390 days, you should lie down a second time. This time, lie on your right side, to represent how long I will punish the sins of the people of Judah. I have determined that you should lie down one day for each of the years that I will punish the people of Judah for their sins against me: 40 days.
4.7: So, you should firmly resolve within yourself with regard to your drawing of the siege of Jerusalem, and stretch out your bare arm against it. As you do this, you must proclaim my prophetic messages against the city.
4.8: Now, pay attention! I am going to tie you down with ropes so you will not be able to turn from one side to the other. You will remain this way until you have finished lying down for the number of days that I have determined for you to do this. \
4.9: As for you, you should acquire portions of wheat, barley, beans, lentils, millet, and rye. You should store these together in a single container and use the mixed grains, seeds, and legumes to bake bread for yourself. You will eat this bread throughout the 390 days during which you lie on your left side.
4.10: Your meals must be weighed into portions of 220 grams a day. You must eat it at fixed times throughout the day.
4.11: Likewise, any water that you drink must be measured to be half a liter. You must also drink at fixed times throughout the day. \
4.12: You should prepare your meals like you would a loaf of barley bread. However, you must bake the bread using human excrement as fuel for the fire, while the Israelite people are watching.”
4.13: Yahweh continued to talk to me. He said, “Your meals that you cook over human excrement will symbolize that the Israelite people will also resort to eating food that is unacceptable to me when I force them out of their land to live among the people groups that surround them.” \
4.14: But I declared, “Oh, Lord Yahweh! Please, do not force me to eat my meals in this ritually impure manner! I have never done anything that caused a priest to declare that I was not able to worship in your presence. As long as I have been alive, I have never once eaten meat of any animal that was found dead or that had been killed by wild animals, nor have I ever eaten any meat that is unacceptable to you!”
4.15: Yahweh replied, “Very well. I will allow you to bake your bread using dried cow manure instead of human excrement for fuel.” \
4.16: Then he said to me, “Human, I am about to remove Jerusalem’s supply of food. When I do this, the people who live in Jerusalem will resort to anxiously rationing their meager meals and fearfully drinking their carefully allocated portions of water.
4.17: This will happen because I will make food and water scarce for the people who live in Jerusalem. Everyone will feel appalled. They will waste away because I am punishing them for the wrongs that they have committed.” \

5.1: “As for you, human, you must acquire a sharp sword and use it like a barber’s razor to shave your head and your beard. Then, you must acquire a scale and weigh the hair that you removed so you can divide it evenly.
5.2: After you complete the acting out of the siege, you must take a third of the hair that you have weighed and burn it in a fire in the middle of your model of the city of Jerusalem. Then, you must take another third of the hair and slash at it with your sword so that it falls all around the model of the city. Then throw the final third of the hair so that it disperses in the wind. I will send enemies to threaten the people that this hair represents. \
5.3: But you must first reserve a few of the hairs from the final third and tie them to the edges of your robe.
5.4: Then, you must take a few of those hairs that you have tied to your robe and throw them into the fire, so that they burn up. After all, a fire in Jerusalem will soon spread and extend to the entirety of the Israelite people. \
5.5: This is what I, the Lord Yahweh, say, ‘This drawing on the clay brick represents the city of Jerusalem. I have positioned this city in the middle of all the people groups, surrounded by other countries.
5.6: However, by doing wicked acts, the people of Jerusalem have rejected the laws that I gave them to live by. They have done this to a greater degree than any of the surrounding people groups or countries! After all, they have refused to do as I have commanded or to obey my laws. \
5.7: For this reason, here is what I, the Lord Yahweh, have to say, “You people of Jerusalem have behaved more proudly than any of the people of the groups around you. Because of this, you have not lived by the laws that I gave you to live by nor have you done what I have commanded you. You have not even lived by the laws of the other people groups around you!”
5.8: For this reason, here is what I, the Lord Yahweh, have to say! Pay attention! Even I, your own God, have become an enemy to you, people of Jerusalem. So, I will justly punish you in the full view of the people groups around you. \
5.9: Yes, I am about to do something to you that is unlike anything I have ever done before or ever will do again. It will all happen because of your disgusting actions.
5.10: As a result, parents among you will resort to eating their own children, and children will resort to eating their own parents. So I will justly punish you. I will disperse any of you who survive in every direction. \
5.11: This is what I, the Lord Yahweh declare and swear by my own life! ‘You have defiled my temple with all your disgusting and unacceptable practices. Because of this, I will withdraw my presence from you. I will not pity you, no, I will certainly punish you.
5.12: One third of the people of Jerusalem will die in the city because of fatal infectious diseases or because of a lack of food. One third of the people will die outside the city because of the fatal wounds inflicted on them by their enemies. I will disperse the remaining third of the people in every direction, but I will cause your enemies to pursue them and threaten to kill them with their swords. \
5.13: Then I will be done being angry, indeed I will calm myself from being so angry with them. When I am no longer angry with them, the people who live in Jerusalem will recognize that I, Yahweh, have said everything that I have declared to them because I want my people to be fully devoted again.
5.14: So, I will destroy Jerusalem until it is nothing but a ruin. I will turn it into such a place that the other people groups that are around them will mock it as they walk past. \
5.15: When I destroy Jerusalem, people will scorn and mock it. But when I justly punish and angrily rebuke them, that will also serve as a terrifying warning to the other people groups that surround them. This will assuredly happen because I, Yahweh, have said it!
5.16: When I cause the people of Jerusalem to suffer severely from lack of food, this will begin to destroy the people. Then I will make the famine even worse. In so doing, I will entirely take away Jerusalem’s supply of food on which they rely.
5.17: Yes, I will cause the people of Jerusalem to suffer a lack of food. But I will also release wild and deadly animals against them. These things will kill many of the people. Many other people will die from diseases and wounds. I will enable their enemies to kill them with their swords. This will all assuredly happen because I, Yahweh, have spoken!’” \

6.1: Yahweh gave me another message. He said,
6.2: “Human, become an opponent of the mountains of Israel and speak against them what I tell you to say.
6.3: You must proclaim, ‘People on the mountains of Israel, attend to what the Lord Yahweh declares! Here is what the Lord Yahweh has to say to you about the mountains and the hilltops, the ravines and the valleys, “Pay attention to what I am about to do! I will soon send enemy soldiers with swords against you. They will destroy all of the high places where you worship other gods. \
6.4: These soldiers will smash and defile your altars for offering sacrifices and for incense. They will kill many of you who will fall down dead in front of the idols that you worship.
6.5: I will put the dead bodies of Israelite people in front of their idols, and I will spread their bones all around your altars for sacrificing to them, thus defiling the altars. \
6.6: Wherever you live, your towns will lie in ruins. You will abandon the high places with the result that the altars there will no longer receive sacrifices to other gods and people will destroy them, as they deserve. Enemies will crush your idols and break apart the altars on which you offered incense to other gods. They will destroy all of the things that you made to worship other gods.
6.7: Enemies will kill many of your people, and their dead bodies will drop all around you. Then you will know that I, Yahweh, am the all-powerful God! \
6.8: However, I will allow some of you to remain alive. Some of you will survive when enemies attack you. Then they will take you to live among other people groups in many other lands.
6.9: Then among the other people groups where enemies forcibly deported you, those of you who remain alive will think about me once again. You will finally realize how much you deeply grieved me. Your deepest desires were like an adulterating spouse, and you yearned to leave your relationship with me and belong to other gods! Then you will feel completely disgusted with yourselves when you think about all of the evil things that you once did with your horrible behavior.
6.10: Then you will know that I, Yahweh, am the all-powerful God! You will realize that when I said that I would cause these disastrous things to happen to you, I would undoubtedly do them!” \
6.11: So, here is what the Lord Yahweh says, “Ezekiel, hit something with your hand and stomp your foot to show how upset you are! Exclaim a wail of lament over every disgustingly wicked thing that the Israelite people do! Because of these things, they are going to die soon — some by their enemies’ swords, some by extreme hunger, and some by infectious diseases.
6.12: Many who are far from Jerusalem will die from disease, and Israel’s enemies will kill many who are close to Jerusalem. Many who remain alive after that will starve to death. Then I will be done punishing them. \
6.13: Their dead bodies will lie among their idols and all around the altars on which they used to offer sacrifices to other gods. This will happen on every hilltop and mountain peak and under every spreading tree, that is, at every place where the Israelite people burned sacrifices and fragrant incense to their idols. When you see this, then you will know that I, Yahweh, am the all-powerful God!
6.14: Yes, I will powerfully confront the Israelite people by causing the entire land of Israel to become a deserted wasteland. I will do this everywhere they have ever lived, from the desert in the south to the town of Diblah in the north. When they see this, then they will know that I, Yahweh, am the all-powerful God!”’” \

7.1: Yahweh gave me another message. He said,
7.2: “Now, as for you, human, here is what I, the Lord Yahweh, have to say to the inhabitants of the land of Israel, ‘The end is here! Yes, it is the end for the entire land of Israel. \
7.3: You people of Israel, your lives are coming to an end. I will soon show you how angry I am with you. I will justly punish you for what you have done and hold you responsible for your disgusting and unacceptable behavior.
7.4: I will not be compassionate to you so that I relent from punishing you. Instead, I will hold you responsible for your way of living, and make you experience just how terrible your disgusting and unacceptable behavior is. Then, you will know that I, Yahweh, am the all-powerful God.’ \
7.5: I, the Lord Yahweh, say this, ‘Something terrible is about to happen, like nothing that has happened before! Pay attention! It will happen soon.
7.6: The end of Israel will certainly happen soon! It is as though it is a ferocious beast and you have awakened it against you! Pay attention! It will happen soon!
7.7: Terrible things will soon happen to you, you who inhabit the land of Israel. The time when Yahweh will punish you is coming soon. At that time, the sound you hear on the mountains will not be joyful shouts, it will be the cries of distressed people! \
7.8: Very soon, I will angrily attack you and fully punish you. I will justly punish you for what you have done and hold you responsible for your disgusting and unacceptable behavior.
7.9: I will not be compassionate to you so that I relent from punishing you. I will hold you responsible for your way of living, and make you experience just how terrible your disgusting and unacceptable behavior is. Then, you will know that I, Yahweh, am the all-powerful God — that I am the one who is attacking you! \
7.10: Pay attention! It is nearly Yahweh’s chosen time to judge you! Pay attention! It is about to happen! You will experience terrible things soon! The punisher is ready, just like a tree that has begun to blossom is ready to bear fruit, and you have grown to be excessively proud.
7.11: It is as though your violent behavior were a seedling that has now grown to become a completely wicked tree. Because of that, nothing that you have will survive — not your large population, nor your riches, nor anything that you are proud of! \
7.12: Now is the moment! It is the time that I, Yahweh, have chosen to judge you! People who buy property should not rejoice over what they have bought, and people who sell property should not be sad about what they have sold. None of that matters since I, Yahweh, am furiously angry with the entire Israelite people!
7.13: You see, the person who sold his property will never return to it during the lifetime of either party. This is because I will not revoke this vision that I have revealed to my prophet about everyone in Israel! Everyone, because of his sin, will die. \
7.14: Israel’s commanders will blow trumpets to call the soldiers to fight and they will have prepared what they need, but there will be no one to respond, because I, Yahweh, am furiously angry with the entire Israelite people and will have killed them!
7.15: The army of Israel’s enemies will be outside the city, while people inside the city will experience infectious diseases and famine. So, enemy soldiers will kill anyone who is out in the fields, and the people who are inside the city will die of famine or disease.
7.16: But there will be some of them who will escape. They will flee to the mountains. They will all moan like doves of the valleys because each of them is so sad about his sinful behavior. \
7.17: Each survivor will be so afraid that their hands will hang limp at their sides and they will urinate on their knees.
7.18: They will wear clothes made from rough cloth to show that they are mourning, and they will be terribly afraid. The expression on people’s faces will show that they feel ashamed, and everyone will shave his head to show his grief.
7.19: They will discard their silver into the streets and treat their gold as if it were as disgusting as menstrual blood. Their silver and gold will not be able to save them when I, Yahweh, severely punish them. They will not be able to use their money to buy food to satisfy their appetites. Rather, it was having a lot of gold and silver that caused them to do evil things! \
7.20: Their beautiful gold and silver jewelry caused the people of Israel to become proud. They used those beautiful things to craft disgusting statues of their false gods. So I, Yahweh, will cause them to regard the silver and gold as if they were as disgusting as menstrual blood.
7.21: Then I will give the silver and gold to strangers who are the most evil people on the earth. They will take it as they plunder the Israelites. These wicked strangers will pollute it by using it to worship false gods.
7.22: Then, I, Yahweh, will abandon the Israelite people. I will allow Israel’s enemies to pollute my beloved land. Yes, violent men will enter it, and they will pollute it. \
7.23: Forge a set of chains, because Israel’s officials deserve them for condemning innocent people to die and for allowing violent people to live freely in the city of Jerusalem!
7.24: So I will summon the armies of the most evil people groups to take the houses of the Israelite people. I will humble those arrogant Israelite people who consider themselves strong, as their enemies pollute the sacred places where they worshiped other gods.
7.25: The enemies of the Israelites will soon terrify them! The the Israelites will try to find a way to be safe but they will be unable to do so. \
7.26: The Israelites will suffer a series of catastrophes, and they will hear rumors about other catastrophes. Then they will beg Yahweh’s prophets to tell them a message from Yahweh but there is none. The priests will have no instructions for them, and the elders will have no wise advice to give them.
7.27: Israel’s king will grieve, and his son will deeply despair. Everywhere in Israel, people will feel afraid and helpless. I will do to the Israelite people what their lifestyles deserve; I will judge them by their own legal standards. Then they will know that I, Yahweh, am the all-powerful God!’” \

8.1: In the sixth year that we had been in Babylon, on the fifth day of the sixth month of that year, I was sitting inside my house, and the elders of Judah were sitting in front of me. Right then and there the Lord Yahweh powerfully revealed to me a message.
8.2: As I watched, I suddenly saw something that looked like a man made of fire. From what looked like his waist and below, he looked like fire. Above his waist, his body was shining brightly, like the glow of hot metal. \
8.3: Then he reached out what looked like a hand and grabbed me by the hair on my head. Then a wind lifted me up and carried me between the earth and the sky. Then, in this vision from God, the wind brought me to Jerusalem. I arrived at the gated entrance to the inner court of the temple, the entrance that faces north. It was the place where there was an idol that made Yahweh very jealous.
8.4: Then, suddenly, I saw there the glorious, brilliant light coming from the God of Israel. It looked just like what I had seen before, when I was in the valley along the Kebar River. \
8.5: Then Yahweh said to me, “Human, look up please and gaze northwards.” So I looked up and gazed northwards. There, just to the north of the gate that led to the altar, I saw that idol that made Yahweh very jealous, sitting at the entrance to the gate.
8.6: Then Yahweh said to me, “Human, just look at what they are doing! The entire Israelite people are doing very disgusting things here that make them disregard my holy temple! You will soon see things that are even more greatly disgusting.” \
8.7: Then Yahweh brought me to the entrance of the temple courtyard. When I looked, I saw that there was a hole in the north wall of the temple!
8.8: Yahweh said to me, “Human, dig into the wall here.” So I started to dig into the wall, and suddenly it opened to the other side!
8.9: Then Yahweh said to me, “Go in through the opening and see the evil, disgusting things that people are doing in there.” \
8.10: So I went in and looked around. I saw there, on the walls all around the room, someone had carved images of every sort of crawling creature and disgusting animal, along with depictions of every idol that the people of Israel worshiped.
8.11: Seventy of the elders of the Israelite people stood facing these carvings. Even Jaazaniah, the son of Shaphan was standing among them! Each man was holding a pan in which incense was burning, and an aromatic cloud of incense smoke was rising up from them. \
8.12: Then Yahweh said to me, “Human, just look at what the elders of the Israelite people are doing in the dark! Each one of them is hiding in an interior room with carved images of his gods! Indeed, they say to themselves, ‘Yahweh cannot see us; he has left the land of Israel.’”
8.13: Then Yahweh said to me, “You will soon see that they are doing things that are even more greatly disgusting.” \
8.14: Then he brought me to the northern gate of the entrance to Yahweh’s temple. There, I saw a group of women sitting. They were performing a ritual lament, weeping for Tammuz!
8.15: Then Yahweh said to me, “Human, just look at what they are doing! You will soon see things that are even more greatly disgusting than these things that you have seen.” \
8.16: He brought me into the interior courtyard of Yahweh’s temple. There I saw something amazing! About 25 men were at the entrance of Yahweh’s temple, between the entrance’s porch and the altar that was in the middle of the interior courtyard. They had turned their backs to Yahweh’s temple and were instead facing east, bowing down to worship the sun! \
8.17: Then Yahweh said to me, “Human, just look at this! Yet, apparently these disgusting practices that the people of Judah are doing here in my temple are not sufficiently bad for them! Indeed, throughout this land they are violent to each other and they are repeatedly making me angry. Yes, consider how in all these ways they are openly disrespecting and mocking me!
8.18: Therefore, for my part I will also act angrily. I will not feel sorry for them or be merciful to them. They will desperately cry out to me, but I will ignore them.” \

9.1: Then I heard Yahweh call out loudly, “You who will punish the people of the city of Jerusalem, approach! Each of you come with your deadly weapon in your hand.”
9.2: Then I saw six men coming from the direction of the upper gate to the temple courtyard, the one that faces north. Each one of them had a war club in his hand. Among them was a man who wore linen clothing with a scribe’s writing kit on his waist. They entered the courtyard and stood beside the bronze altar. \
9.3: Then the glorious, brilliant light coming from the God of Israel ascended from where it had been above the cherubs on the ark of the covenant, and it moved to the doorstep of Yahweh’s temple. Then Yahweh spoke to the man who wore the linen clothing, who also had the scribal writing kit at his waist.
9.4: Yahweh said to him, “Go throughout the city of Jerusalem. As you do, make a mark on the foreheads of every person who laments and grieves over all of the disgusting things that the people are doing in the city.” \
9.5: While I was listening, Yahweh said to the six other men, “Follow that man through the city and kill everyone whom he does not mark. Do not allow yourself to feel sorry for them; you must kill them.
9.6: Kill the old and young men, the old and young women, and the children. But you must not harm anyone whose forehead has the mark on it. Now, begin with the people at my temple.” So they began with the elders who were bowing down to worship the sun in front of Yahweh’s temple. \
9.7: Then Yahweh said to the six men, “Desecrate my temple by filling its courtyards with the dead bodies of the people whom you kill! Go do it!” So they went out and started killing people in the city.
9.8: As the six men went out killing, I remained there alone. I threw myself face down on the ground and exclaimed, “Oh, Lord Yahweh! Are you so angry with the people of Jerusalem that you are going to completely destroy everyone who remains of the Israelite people? \
9.9: He answered me, “The people of Israel and Judah have sinned a lot in horrible ways. Throughout the land they are killing each other, and the people in this city are thoroughly corrupt! They excuse themselves by saying to each other, ‘Yahweh has left this land’ and, ‘Yahweh can no longer see what we are doing.’
9.10: Therefore, I myself will not feel sorry for them or be merciful to them. Instead, I will consider them to be responsible for the way that they have lived.”
9.11: Then the man who wore the linen clothing, who also had strapped the scribal kit to his waist, appeared. He reported to Yahweh, “I have done exactly as you commanded me to do.” \

10.1: Then, as I watched, suddenly a shape appeared above the dome that arched high over the heads of the four cherubs. It looked like a throne made of a very large sapphire stone.
10.2: Yahweh then spoke to the man who wore the linen clothing. He said, “Go to the spaces in between the set of wheels that are under the cherubs. Take two handfuls of the burning coals from between the cherubs, and scatter them over the city of Jerusalem.” Then, as I watched, the man went. \
10.3: Now, when the man went in to collect the burning coals, the four cherubs were standing on the south side of the temple, and a thick cloud filled the temple’s inner courtyard.
10.4: Then the glorious, brilliant light coming from Yahweh rose up from above the four cherubs and went to the doorway of Yahweh’s temple. The thick cloud filled the temple, and the glorious, brilliant light coming from Yahweh brightly lit up the temple’s interior courtyard.
10.5: Then as the cherubs moved their wings, the roar that the wings made was so loud that people in the outer courtyard of the temple could hear it! It was like the voice of the all-powerful God. \
10.6: Now, when Yahweh had commanded the man who wore the linen clothing to take burning coals from among the array of wheels that was between the cherubs, the man went and stood beside one of the four wheels.
10.7: Then one of the cherubs reached out his hand from where the cherubs were down into the fire that burned between the four cherubs. He scooped up some of the burning coals and put them into the open hands of the man who wore the linen clothing. Then the man took them and left.
10.8: ( You see, each cherub had what looked like human hands under its wings.) \
10.9: Then as I watched, I noticed again the four wheels that moved beside the four cherubs. Each cherub had a single wheel beside it. The wheels themselves appeared to shine like a fine topaz.
10.10: As for their appearance, all four wheels were identical: Each one looked like a single wheel inside of another wheel.
10.11: Whenever the wheels advanced, they never had to swivel. Instead, they always advanced straight forward in one of the four directions corresponding to the direction that each of cherubs looked. \
10.12: The entirety of the cherubs — their bodies, their backs, their hands, their wings — and all four wheels were completely covered with eyes.
10.13: I heard someone identify the cherubs’s wheels as “the array of wheels.”
10.14: Now, each winged creature possessed four faces — first, a cherub’s face; then a human face; third, a lion’s face; and fourth, an eagle’s face. \
10.15: Then the four cherubs ascended. ( These were the same creatures that I had previously seen beside the Kebar River.)
10.16: When the cherubs advanced, their wheels advanced beside them. Similarly, when the cherubs extended their wings in order to ascend from the ground, so also the wheels themselves stayed in their places beside them.
10.17: Whenever the cherubs stopped moving, their wheels also stopped. Whenever the cherubs ascended, their wheels also ascended alongside them. This was because the creatures’s spirit was in the wheels. \
10.18: Then the glorious, brilliant light coming from Yahweh moved away from above the doorstep of Yahweh’s temple and stopped above the cherubs.
10.19: Then, as I watched, the cherubs extended their wings and ascended from the ground. Their wheels ascended beside them as they went. Then the procession of Yahweh and the four cherubs stopped at the doorway of the eastern entrance to Yahweh’s temple. The glorious, brilliant light coming from the God of Israel hovered above the cherubs. \
10.20: Yes, these were the same creatures that I had seen carrying the God of Israel beside the Kebar River. Now I knew that they were cherubs.
10.21: Each of the four cherubs possessed four faces and four wings, and underneath their wings, they possessed what resembled human hands.
10.22: As for the appearance of their faces, they were the same faces that I saw alongside the Kebar River. They looked like the same creatures, and they were the same creatures. They moved together in the same way, as well, in the direction of one of their four faces. \

11.1: Then a wind lifted me up and carried me to the eastern gated entrance of Yahweh’s temple. There, standing at the gate, I suddenly noticed 25 men. Among them, I recognized two public officials: Jaazaniah, the son of Azzur, and Pelatiah, the son of Benaiah. \
11.2: Yahweh said to me, “Human, these are the men who have made thinking about doing corrupt things a habit and consistently give the peoples of Jerusalem immoral and disastrous advice.
11.3: These men tell the people in their jurisdiction, ‘It is not the right moment to think about building houses. This city keeps us, its most honorable and divinely-favored officials, safe, just as a storage pot conserves the choice meat that is inside it.’
11.4: So, declare my prophetic pronouncements against them! Yes, prophesy human!” \
11.5: Then Yahweh’s Spirit empowered me, and Yahweh told me to declare these words, “Here is what Yahweh has to say, ‘Israelite people, you have been talking like this in public, but I, Yahweh, know exactly what you are thinking!
11.6: You have killed innumerable people in this city. Dead bodies lie everywhere on every street in Jerusalem!’
11.7: Consequently, here is what the Lord Yahweh has to say, ‘The corpses that you have strewn throughout this city are like the meat, and this city is like the storage pot. But as for you — I will forcibly remove you from Jerusalem. \
11.8: You are afraid of dying in the violent conflict of war. So I will dispatch the violent conflict of war against you.’ That is what the Lord Yahweh declares!
11.9: ‘I, Yahweh, will forcibly remove you from this city, Jerusalem, and make foreign empires rule over you. This is how I will punish you.
11.10: Your armed enemies will kill you with their weapons. I will enforce my legal rulings against you within the tribal territories of the Israelite people. At that time, you will know that I, Yahweh, am the all-powerful God! \
11.11: This city, Jerusalem, will not preserve you the way a storage pot conserves meat within it. To the contrary, I will punish you within the tribal territories of the Israelite people.
11.12: At that time, you will finally know that I, Yahweh, am the all-powerful God! It is my instructions and my norms that you have ignored and refused to live by. Instead, you have chosen to live by the norms of the other people groups around you!’” \
11.13: Then, as I was prophesying, Pelatiah son of Benaiah suddenly died. I threw myself face down on the ground and exclaimed with a shout, “O Lord Yahweh! You are going to completely eradicate the only Israelite people who remain alive!” \
11.14: Then Yahweh gave me another message. He said,
11.15: “Human, the people who yet live in the city of Jerusalem are making claims about you and your relatives — your closest family — and about all the rest of the Israelite people whom the Babylonians forcibly removed from Israel. Those left in Jerusalem claim, ‘Let those exiles remain far away from Yahweh. After all, Yahweh has conferred this land to us as our property.’
11.16: Consequently, inform them, ‘Here is what the Lord Yahweh has to say, “Yes, I resettled the exiles among the people groups far away and strewed them among the neighboring empires. Nonetheless, wherever they now live, I have been with them. I will lovingly protect them, as if I were a sacred refuge for them.”’
11.17: Also inform them, ‘Here is what the Lord Yahweh has to say, “When I bring all of you back from your exile among the non-Israelite peoples, and I regather you from the empires among which I scattered you, I will give you back the Israelite territory.
11.18: Then those whom the Babylonians forcibly removed from Israel will return to their homelands. They will deface and destroy every detestable ritual statue and every disgusting and indecent idol, entirely removing them from the Israelite territory. \
11.19: At that time, I will unify the entire Israelite people so that they feel, think, and live together in harmony. It will be as if they all have one mind! I will also revive and empower the Israelite people with a new desire to live as I want them to. It will be as if I have given them a new life! I will change the arrogant, stubborn, and ineffective ways they used to feel, think, and live. In their place, I will enable the Israelite people to deeply desire to feel, think, and live as I want them to. It will be as if I removed a dead, rocky heart from them and put a living, responsive heart in its place.
11.20: This unified mind and renewed life that I will give to the Israelite people will enable them to carefully live their lives by practicing the norms and instructions that I disclosed to them. When this happens, you, Israelite people, will finally and truly live as my special people, and I myself will belong to you as the only God that you worship, love, and trust.
11.21: Yet, those Israelite people who devote themselves to worshiping other gods by honoring their detestable ritual images and their disgusting and indecent idols — I will repay them for their rebellion.” That is what the Lord Yahweh declares.’” \
11.22: Then the winged cherubs raised their four wings, with their wheels beside them, while the glorious, brilliant light coming from Israel’s God hovered above them.
11.23: Then, glorious, brilliant light coming from Yahweh rose from where it had been hovering in the middle of Jerusalem. It halted above the mountain on the eastern side of the city. \
11.24: At that moment, as the Spirit of God showed me what he wanted me to see, the wind of Yahweh’s Spirit raised me up and brought me back to the domains of the Babylonian empire, where the Israelite exiles were currently living. Then I stopped seeing the prophetic visions Yahweh had been giving me.
11.25: Then I began to tell the Israelite exiles everything that Yahweh had shown me. \

12.1: Then Yahweh spoke another message to me. He said,
12.2: “Human, you live amidst the Israelite people, who reject my authority and openly defy me! They may have eyes that can see, but the people refuse to perceive their actions the way I do. They may have ears that can hear, but the people refuse to heed my messages to them. After all, these people reject my authority and openly defy me! \
12.3: As for you, human pack your belongings as if an enemy army was forcibly removing you from your homeland. During the daytime, you should act as though enemy armies were forcibly removing you from your home, and, as these people watch, you should travel to another place. Even though these people reject my authority and openly defy me, perhaps your actions will help them to understand their actions the way that I do. \
12.4: When it is daytime, you should bring the bag you prepared out of your house while they watch, like an exile would if an enemy army forcibly removed him from his home. But then, as the people continue to watch, you should leave your home in the evening, just as an exile would.
12.5: Next, as they watch, you must begin to dig a hole through the wall of your house and carry the bag you prepared out through the hole.
12.6: While they continue to watch, you should hoist your bag onto your shoulder. Then, just before the sun goes down, carry it out through the hole you dug. As you come out of the hole in your wall, you must cover your face with a cloth so that you are unable to see the land. I am using what you do to teach the Israelites.” \
12.7: So I did exactly what Yahweh commanded me to do. In the daytime, I brought the bag that I prepared out of my house, just as an exile might do. Then, in the evening, I used my hands to dig myself a hole in the wall of my house. Just before it became dark, I hoisted my bag onto my shoulder and, as the Israelite exiles watched, I carried it back out of my house through the hole in the wall. \
12.8: The next morning, Yahweh spoke this message to me,
12.9: “Human, the rebellious Israelites asked you what you are doing.
12.10: So, tell them what I, the Lord Yahweh, have to say, ‘This heavy bag that I carry on my shoulder represents the ruler of Jerusalem, and all the Israelite people who live in Jerusalem.’ \
12.11: Tell them, ‘Yahweh wants you to learn from what I am doing. Notice what I have done. The same thing will happen to the peoples of Jerusalem: Their enemies will march them out of Jerusalem as exiles and prisoners.’
12.12: The ruler of the peoples of Jerusalem will hoist a bag onto his shoulder as it is getting dark, and he will leave the city. Someone will dig a hole through the walls of Jerusalem, to carry the ruler out through. As he departs, the ruler will cover his face with a cloth so that he does not see the place that he is leaving.
12.13: However, I will allow enemies to trap and capture the ruler, as if he was in a hunting trap. Then, I will cause them to bring him to the city of Babylon, where the Chaldian people live ( but he will not be able to see that place ). He will die there. \
12.14: I will disperse his entire retinue in every direction — his advisors and all his military troops. I will dispatch enemy soldiers with swords to hunt them.
12.15: Then, when I forcibly relocated them among the many people groups and countries, they will all finally know that I, Yahweh, am the all-powerful God!
12.16: Yet, I will allow a few of them to survive the violence of war, the fatal lack of food, and the wasting infectious diseases. As a result, when they settle among the people groups where their enemies relocate them, they will report all the disgusting and indecent things that they once did. When this happens, the people who hear these reports will finally know that I, Yahweh, am the all-powerful God!” \
12.17: Yahweh spoke another message to me. He said,
12.18: “Human, you should tremble with fear while you eat your food, and shudder anxiously while you drink your water. \
12.19: Tell the people of the regions of Israel, ‘Here is what the Lord Yahweh has to say to those who still live in Jerusalem about the land in Israel, “They will be anxious while they eat their food, and they will tremble in devastated horror while they drink their water. After all, Israel’s enemies will devastate the land by destroying every kind of crop that grows in Israel. This will happen because everyone who lives in the Israelite regions continues to harm one another violently.
12.20: Israel’s enemies will raze Israel’s cities in which people live until they are nothing but ruins, and the land itself will become an empty, devastated wasteland. Then, those who remain alive in the Israelite regions will finally know that I, Yahweh, am the all-powerful God!”’” \
12.21: Yahweh spoke another message to me. He said,
12.22: “Human, the people who remain alive in Israel keep repeating this saying about the Israelite regions, ‘The days go by, but nothing that the prophets declared in their divine visions ever happens.’
12.23: So tell them, ‘Here is what the Lord Yahweh has to say, “I am making this colloquial saying irrelevant and no longer true. The Israelite people will never again speak it.”’ However, also inform them, ‘Soon, everything that the prophets have declared in their divine visions will happen! \
12.24: From now on, no prophet among the Israelite people will declare deceitful visions that they fabricated, nor will they read divine messages from nature only to flatter people with positive messages.
12.25: Surely I, Yahweh, still speak! And I will accomplish what I have spoken! It will happen exactly when I declare that it will. Yes, while you — you Israelite people who reject my authority and revolt against me — are still alive, I will accomplish what I have spoken. That is what I, the Lord Yahweh, declare.’” \
12.26: Then Yahweh spoke another message to me. He said,
12.27: “Human, pay attention! Notice how the Israelite people keep remarking, ‘The prophetic messages that this man, Ezekiel, sees in his divine visions concern events far into the future. Surely, he is proclaiming prophetic messages that only pertain to generations who live after us!’
12.28: So, tell them, ‘Here is what the Lord Yahweh has to say about that, “The things that I have spoken about will happen now, exactly when I declared that they will! Yes, I am about to accomplish what I have spoken.” This is what the Lord Yahweh declares!’” \

13.1: Yahweh gave me another message. He said,
13.2: “Human, speak my prophetic messages against those Israelite prophets who seem to speak authoritatively to the people. Some of them tell people things that they have contrived as if I said them! Tell them, ‘Listen to what Yahweh really says!
13.3: Here is what the Lord Yahweh has to say to you, “How terrible it will be for those senseless prophets who authoritatively speak like my prophet but only heed their own ideas without having received any messages from me!
13.4: Israelite people, the prophets who advise you and speak to you have become useless and predatory —like ravenous jackals that scavenge among the ruins of a city. \
13.5: Like masons who fail to repair the cracks in deteriorating defensive walls, you prophets have done nothing to protect your people! You have not prepared the Israelite people to survive the coming destruction that will occur when I, Yahweh, cause enemies to besiege and destroy Jerusalem!
13.6: The visions and prophecies of those prophets are false. They say, ‘Yahweh told me this,’ but I have not sent them to you. But they expect that what they prophesy will truly happen!
13.7: They say that they have seen visions, but those visions are false, and the things that they prophesy are lies. They say, “Yahweh told me this,” but I have told them nothing! \
13.8: So, here is what the Lord Yahweh has to say, “You prophets have only spoken deceitfully and fraudulently! You have lied when you reported messages that you said came from me! Consequently, pay attention! I am now your enemy. That is what I, the Lord Yahweh, declare.
13.9: I will work against you prophets who deceitfully and fraudulently claim to receive messages from me and who falsely claim to provide divine insight. You will no longer be a part of the community of my people, Israel. No one will record your names in the civil register of the Israelite people. You will never return to the territories of Israel. When all this happens, you false prophets will finally understand that I, the Lord Yahweh, am the all-powerful God! \
13.10: I oppose these false prophets because they deceive my people, the Israelites, by proclaiming, ‘Everything is well!’ when nothing is well! It is as though someone has built a weak wall without the mortar. Then these false prophets are so bold that they cover the weak wall with whitewash to make it look stable.
13.11: So, tell those prophets who cover the wall with whitewash that it will rain very hard. I will cause big hailstones to fall from the sky. Very strong winds will blow against the wall and it will surely fall down.
13.12: When the wall collapses, people will surely mock you false prophets for whitewashing a weak wall.” \
13.13: So here is what the Lord Yahweh has to say to you, false prophets, “I am angrily unleashing violent windstorms, furiously unloading flooding rainstorms, and irately sending falling hailstones until I destroy that wall completely.
13.14: I will raze the wall that you painted with whitewash. I will knock it to the ground so that everyone can see its foundation. It will collapse, and you will die alongside it. When all this happens, you false prophets will finally know that I, Yahweh, am the all-powerful God! \
13.15: In that way I will show that I am very angry with the Israelite officials’ wall and against those false prophets who painted it with whitewash. At that time, I will say to you, ‘Your wall is gone, and so are those who painted it —
13.16: those false Israelite prophets who prophesy about the peoples of Jerusalem and claim to receive divine declarations from me that all would be well for the people in the city, when nothing will be well! That is what I, the Lord Yahweh, declare.’” \
13.17: Now you human, become an opponent of the Israelite women who speak as if they had an authoritative message for the people. Some of these women tell people things that they have contrived as if I said them! Declare my prophetic messages against them.
13.18: Tell them, ‘Here is what the Lord Yahweh has to say, “How terrible it will be for you women who manufacture magic bands to fasten on people’s wrists, who craft magic talismans that you encourage people of all sizes to wear over their heads! You do these things not to help people but to ensnare and harm them! Yes, you attempt to ensnare my people, Israel, and harm them. But I will ensnare and harm you! \
13.19: You have caused my people to dishonor me in exchange for a few handfuls of barley and a few scraps of bread! By lying to my people, who heed your lies, you caused to die people who did not deserve to die and have allowed to remain alive those who should not continue to live.” \
13.20: So, here is what the Lord Yahweh has to say, “Witness me! I am now an enemy to your magic bands, which you use to ensnare people as though they were birds. I will rip those magic bands off your forearms, and I will release the people whom you attempt to ensnare and harm like birds.
13.21: I will also rip off your magic talismans to deliver my people, Israel, from your control. You will no longer dominate and harm them, as though they were birds that you hunted for sport. Then, you false prophetesses will finally know that I, Yahweh, am the all-powerful God! \
13.22: You have demoralized honest people by lying to them — even though I myself did nothing to cause them emotional pain! You have also encouraged dishonest and immoral people! As a result, these people did not stop their corrupt behavior — or else they would have stayed alive. Because of these actions,
13.23: you will no longer claim to receive deceitful and fraudulent messages from me or provide divine insight to people! Instead, I will deliver my people, Israel, from your control. Then, when all this happens, you false prophetesses will finally know that I, Yahweh, am the all-powerful God!’” \

14.1: One day, some of the elders of the Israelite people came to me and sat down in front of me.
14.2: Then Yahweh gave me this message,
14.3: “Human, these elderly men have devotedly committed themselves to their ritual statues. They have fixed their attention on those idols, which has caused them to behave immorally! Why are these men asking me what to do? They certainly have no right to ask me for advice! \
14.4: So, tell them, ‘Here is what the Lord Yahweh has to say, “Any Israelite could devotedly commit himself to his ritual statues and fix his attention on those idols that cause him to behave immorally. But whenever such a person then comes to one of Yahweh’s prophets to request advice from me, I, Yahweh, will answer him myself — in such a way that his extensive worship of innumerable idols deserves!
14.5: I will answer them in this way so that I may capture the devoted attention and affection of the Israelite people — all of whom have alienated themselves from me by worshiping other gods through their ritual statues.”’ \
14.6: Consequently, tell the Israelite people, ‘Here is what the Lord Yahweh has to say, “Repent! Stop worshiping your idols, and stop all your other disgusting and indecent practices! \
14.7: Any Israelite, or any foreigner living among the Israelite people, could ritually dedicate himself to another god and disavow me and then begin to commit himself devotedly to his ritual statues and fix his attention on those idols that cause him to behave immorally. But whenever such a person then comes to one of Yahweh’s prophets and asks him for my insight, I, Yahweh, will answer him personally.
14.8: I will become that man’s enemy and oppose him. I will make what happens to him a warning to others and something that people talk about in their proverbs. I will make that person an outcast from the Israelite people. Then, when all this happens, my people, Israel, will finally understand that I, Yahweh, am the all-powerful God! \
14.9: Suppose a prophet allows someone to convince him to prophesy falsely. If this happens, then I, Yahweh, am the one who convinced him. I will use my power to get rid of him and remove him from among my Israelite people.
14.10: I will hold accountable both the prophet and the person who asks him for my insight. Yes, I will consider them equally guilty.
14.11: I will do this so that the Israelite people will remain devoted to me, no longer straying away from me. They will no longer rebel against me in such a way that makes them ritually unfit to worship me. They will be my people, and I will be their God.” That is what the Lord Yahweh declares.’” \
14.12: Then Yahweh gave me another message. He said,
14.13: “Human, suppose a group of people disloyally betray their promises to me and so act sinfully. Suppose I used my power against them, and I crippled their food supply on which they rely, and so caused the conditions for a fatal lack of food among them. Suppose I caused the deaths of many people and animals there.
14.14: If that were to happen, even if the most virtuous people imaginable lived among those people — men like Noah, Daniel, and Job — those men’s virtuous actions could not stop me from destroying the people. Their virtuous actions would only save themselves. That is what I, the Lord Yahweh, declare. \
14.15: Or suppose I sent rampaging animals throughout the homeland of those people. Suppose the wild animals attacked and killed so many people that those who survived deserted the region, and no one traveled through it because of those animals.
14.16: I, Yahweh, swear by my own life that even if those three virtuous men lived in that region they would not be able to prevent the deaths of even their own sons or daughters. Only those three men would remain alive, while the entire region would become ruinous and desolate. That is what I, the Lord Yahweh, declare. \
14.17: Or suppose I dispatched the armed forces of an enemy empire against that region. Suppose I proclaimed, ‘May enemy soldiers bring their swords and wage war throughout the region!’ and then that they murdered both people and animals there.
14.18: I, Yahweh, swear by my own life that even if those three men lived in that region, they would not be able to prevent the deaths of even their own sons or daughters. Yes, those three men alone would remain alive. That is what I, the Lord Yahweh, declare. \
14.19: Or suppose I angrily cause the deaths of many people and animals by a fatal infectious disease throughout that region.
14.20: I, Yahweh, swear by my own life that even if the most virtuous people imaginable lived in that region — men like Noah, Daniel, and Job — they would not be able to prevent the deaths of even their own sons or daughters. Their virtuous actions would only save themselves. That is what I, the Lord Yahweh, declare. \
14.21: So this is what I, the Lord Yahweh, say, ‘It will be far worse for the peoples of Jerusalem! I will cause the deaths of both people and animals in Jerusalem when I unleash all four of my calamitous punishments: Armed soldiers will murder some with their swords, a fatal lack of food in the city will kill some, raging wild animals will kill others, and lethal infectious diseases will kill still others. \
14.22: But pay attention! Some of the peoples of Jerusalem will survive these disasters. Watch for them! I will take the survivors out of the city, both sons and daughters, and they will travel to you in exile in the Babylonian Empire. When you observe their lifestyles and how they have conducted themselves, you will feel relief about all the calamities that I unleashed against the city of Jerusalem.
14.23: When you observe the lifestyles of those survivors and how they have conducted themselves, you will feel relieved. You will understand that I was just to do everything that I did to Jerusalem.’ That is what I, the Lord Yahweh, declare.” \

15.1: Yahweh gave me another message. He said,
15.2: “Human, what do people do with the woody stock of grapevines — that is, with the vine branches that people find growing among forested trees?
15.3: No one uses the woody stock from a grapevine to make anything useful. No one even makes a peg with it on which to hang things!
15.4: Pay attention! They simply burn it as fuel for fires. The fire burns both ends and eventually destroys even its middle. It is good for nothing else! \
15.5: Think about it! Even when the grapevine branch was still in one piece, no one made anything useful with it. So, now that the fire has burned it up, certainly no one will use it to make anything useful!
15.6: So this is what I, the Lord Yahweh, say, ‘The peoples of Jerusalem will suffer the same fate as the woody stock of the grapevine — the ones that people find growing among the forested trees, which they use as fuel for fires. \
15.7: I have become their enemy. Even though the people who currently live in Jerusalem have escaped destruction before, the coming disasters will annihilate them. When I act as their enemy, you who live in exile in the Babylonian Empire will finally know that I, Yahweh, am the all-powerful God!
15.8: I will transform the land into a desolate and ruinous wasteland — all because these people disloyally betrayed their promises to me.’ That is what the Lord Yahweh declares.” \

16.1: Yahweh gave me another message. He said,
16.2: “Human, inform the peoples of Jerusalem of the disgusting and illicit things that they have done.
16.3: Tell them, ‘This is what the Lord Yahweh has to say to you peoples of Jerusalem, “Imagine that this city and those who live in it were a woman. Her ancestry was Canaanite, from the regions where the Canaanites lived. Your father was ethnically Amorite, and your mother was ethnically Hittite. \
16.4: Imagine your birth story: On the day your mother gave birth to you, no one cut your umbilical cord; no one bathed you to ritually cleanse you, and no one rubbed you with salt or swaddled you in cloths.
16.5: No one who saw you felt enough empathy for you to do any of those things for you or to spare you from your condition. Instead, on the day she gave birth to you, your mother despised you so much that she threw you out into an open field. \
16.6: Then I came across you and witnessed you floundering in your own spilt blood. As you lay there, helpless in your blood, I said to you, ‘Live! Yes, live!’
16.7: I caused you to flourish like a sprouting plant growing in a field. You grew tall and came to a marriageable age, wearing the finest jewelry. Your body matured, and your hair grew long. However, you were still completely naked. \
16.8: Later, when I came across you, I looked at you again. I noticed that you were now old enough to marry. So I covered your naked body with the edge of my clothing to demonstrate that I would marry you and protect you. I made a solemn promise to you and entered into a marriage covenant with you, and you became my wife.” That is what the Lord Yahweh declares. \
16.9: “Then I bathed you, washed the blood off you, and rubbed olive oil onto your skin.
16.10: Then I dressed you in colorful embroidered clothing and strapped leather sandals to your feet. I outfitted you in fine linen and clad you in silken cloth.
16.11: I adorned you with fine jewelry: I fastened bracelets on your wrists and a chain necklace around your neck.
16.12: I gave you a nose ring and earrings and placed a beautiful crown on your head. \
16.13: So you wore gold and silver jewelry, and you dressed in the finest linen clothing, silken cloth, and colorful embroidery. Your food comprised the finest flour, honey, and olive oil. So, you became exceedingly beautiful, and you became a queen.
16.14: You gained a reputation for being so exceedingly beautiful that people in other people groups heard about you. After all, the magnificent radiance that I, your husband, had given you made you perfectly beautiful.” That is what the Lord Yahweh declares. \
16.15: “Yet, your beauty made you self-assured. You used your international renown to act like a prostitute. You freely offered illicit sexual favors to every man you came across, and they enjoyed your beautiful body.
16.16: You used some of your beautiful clothing to make yourself gaudy, decorated shrines. On them, you behaved like a prostitute. Yes, you had illicit sex with men, and they enjoyed your beautiful body. \
16.17: You also used the beautiful gold and silver jewelry that I had given you to fashion ritual statues with male anatomy, and you had illicit sexual relations with them.
16.18: You took your embroidered clothes and clothed your ritual statues with them, and you placed my oil and my incense as votive offerings in their presence.
16.19: You also took the food that I gave you — the fine flour, olive oil, and honey that I fed you — and you presented it in the presence of those ritual statues as pleasingly aromatic votive offerings. That is exactly what happened.” That is what the Lord Yahweh declares. \
16.20: “You even took your sons and your daughters, the children that you had borne to me, and you sacrificed them as food to those idols. Was your prostitution such a small matter to you,
16.21: that you also butchered my children and burned them alive as offerings to those ritual statues?
16.22: All the while, when you were committing these disgusting, heinous actions and prostituting yourself, you never once remembered your birth story, when you were completely naked, floundering in your own blood! \
16.23: How terrible it will be for you!” That is what the Lord Yahweh declares! “So, after you did all those heinous acts,
16.24: you constructed a domed building for yourself and erected lofty shrines in every public square. \
16.25: At every street intersection, you constructed your lofty shrine. So you made your once-beautiful body abominable, offering yourself to every man you came across. So, more and more, you behaved like a prostitute.
16.26: Then you even had illicit sex with the Egyptians, your well-endowed neighbors, and so you acted more and more like a prostitute, never ceasing to anger and grieve me. \
16.27: So I acted powerfully against you and reduced your apportioned rations. So I let the Philistine people do what they wanted with you. They despised you, and yet your obscene behavior embarrassed them!
16.28: You also had illicit sexual relations with the Assyrian people because you were insatiable. You behaved like a prostitute with them, and yet even then you could not satisfy your desires!
16.29: So, you behaved more and more like a prostitute, reaching all the way to the territories of the Babylonian Empire! Yet even that did not satisfy your desires! \
16.30: How weak-willed you are! You love the wrong things!” That is what the Lord Yahweh declares. “You did all these things, acting like an impudent prostitute who does whatever she wants.
16.31: When you constructed your domed brothel at every street intersection and erected your lofty shrines in every public square, you were not even like an ordinary prostitute, because you refused to accept payment. \
16.32: You are an unfaithful wife, who prefers strangers to her own husband!
16.33: Prostitutes usually receive gifts from men, but you gave your gifts to all your lovers; you bribed them to come to you from all around to have illicit sexual relations with you!
16.34: So as you behaved like a prostitute, you were the opposite of other women. No man solicited you; instead, you paid them, and they did not pay you. In this way, you were the exact opposite of a normal prostitute!” \
16.35: So then, you prostitute, heed Yahweh’s message!
16.36: This is what the Lord Yahweh says, “You lustfully offered yourself and exposed your naked body in your illicit sexual relations with your lovers. Furthermore, you crafted your disgusting and indecent ritual statues, and you offered those idols the blood of your own children!
16.37: Because of this, I am summoning all your lovers, the ones you found so attractive — everyone you loved, along with everyone you hated. I will assemble them against you from all around, and I will strip you naked in front of them so that they will see you completely naked. \
16.38: I will execute against you the legal sentence reserved for women who commit adultery and women who murder. I will sentence you to an angry and impassioned, bloody death.
16.39: I will let your enemies dominate you: They will demolish your brothels and smash your lofty places. They will strip off your clothes and take your beautiful jewelry, and they will leave you completely naked. \
16.40: They will bring a mob against you. Then, they will stone you to death and cut your body into pieces with their swords.
16.41: They will burn down your houses and execute their judgments against you while many women watch. I will put an end to your prostituting behavior, and you will no longer pay your lovers.
16.42: Then I will vent my fury against you, and my jealous passion will leave you alone. I will calm myself down and cease being angry. \
16.43: Because you did not remember your birth story, but instead you infuriated me with all these deeds, I hereby declare that I will hold you accountable for your behavior. That is what I, the Lord Yahweh, declare! You have added this obscene behavior to all your other disgusting and indecent practices! \
16.44: Now, pay attention! Everyone who quotes proverbs will quote this proverb about you: ‘The daughter is just like her mother.’
16.45: You are truly your mother’s daughter. She abhorred her husband and her children. You are also just like your sisters. They abhorred their husbands and their children. After all, your mother was ethnically Hittite, and your father was ethnically Amorite! \
16.46: Now, your older sister is named Samaria. She resides with her daughters to the north of you, peoples of Jerusalem. Your younger sister is named Sodom. She resides with her daughters to the south of you. \
16.47: You did not merely practice their lifestyles or do the disgusting things they did. Instead, in a surprisingly short while, in all your habits and practices, you became even more corrupt than they ever were!”
16.48: This is what the Lord Yahweh declares, “I swear by my own life that your sister Sodom and her daughters never did what you, Jerusalem, and your daughters have done. \
16.49: Take note! This is how corrupt your sister Sodom was: She and her daughters were arrogant; they had plenty of food and lived comfortably at ease, but they never helped those who were poor or needy.
16.50: They were arrogant and did disgusting and illicit things in my presence. So, when I saw what they were doing, I forcibly removed them from my presence. \
16.51: As for Samaria, she did not commit even half the sins that you committed. You have done so many more disgusting and illicit things than either Samaria or Sodom did, so that your abominable acts have made your sisters appear righteous!
16.52: So now you must feel the emotional disgrace of having interceded for your sisters. Your sins, which were far more disgusting and illicit than theirs, have made your sisters appear more righteous than you! So you also must be ashamed and feel the disgrace of having made your sisters, Sodom and Samaria, appear righteous. \
16.53: Nevertheless, I will restore the well-being of your sisters — that of Sodom and her daughters, and of Samaria and her daughters — and I will restore your well-bring along with theirs,
16.54: so that you will feel humiliated and ashamed of all that you did when your disgusting behavior consoled your sisters.
16.55: I will restore all of you —your sisters, Sodom and her daughters, Samaria and her daughters, and you and your daughters as well — to the kind of life you enjoyed before you suffered my punishments. \
16.56: When you were arrogant, you would not even mention your sister Sodom.
16.57: But that was before I exposed your own corrupt and depraved behavior. Now, you are just like your sister Sodom! The people of Aram and all her neighbors, and the Philistines all around you, mock you and despise you!
16.58: You yourself have suffered the consequences of your obscene behavior and your disgusting, illicit practices.” That is what Yahweh declares. \
